figures.finding: Anyone paying a person resident abroad for self-employed or similar work (as an artist or professional) must withhold a final 20%.

value.base: fees for self-employed or assimilated work (art. 27)

figures.applies: Law 166/2013 art. 102(1) as replaced by Law 141/2025 art. 32, in force from November 2025.

sources.said: che corrispondano, anche occasionalmente, compensi in denaro o natura o comunque denominati per prestazioni di lavoro autonomo o assimilate, così come definite dall’articolo 27, a soggetti residenti all’estero, anche quando le prestazioni siano effettuate in regime d’impresa, devono operare una ritenuta a titolo d’imposta del 20 per cento.
LEGGE 12 novembre 2025 n.141 MODIFICHE ALLA LEGGE 16 DICEMBRE 2013 N.166 “IMPOSTA GENERALE SUI REDDITI” E SUCCESSIVE MODIFICHE

figures.finding: The resident's progressive brackets (Annex C of Law 166/2013) are indexed every two years to the cost of living, capped at six points, the first indexation in tax year 2028; the 2026 bracket amounts themselves were not read.

sources.said: Gli scaglioni sono adeguati automaticamente ogni biennio in funzione dell’incremento dell’indice del costo della vita.
Il primo adeguamento è effettuato nel periodo di imposta 2028.

figures.finding: For 2026 an employee pays 7.80% of pay in social contributions (6.90% of it to the Pension Fund) and the employer 17.60% to the Pension Fund; a self-employed professional or worker (a freelance screen worker) pays 24% to the Pension Fund and 2% social security on declared income up to €50,294.28, on a minimum income of €30,164.57, plus 2% on income above that ceiling.
figures.applies: Employees and self-employed workers (libero professionista, lavoratore autonomo) in 2026 under Law 157/2022; the employer's contributions other than the Pension Fund are not in this circular.

figures.finding: An employer withholds tax on account from a resident's pay in proportion to the presumable annual income at the rates in force, after the deductions and credits the employee declares; from 2026.

value.method: on-account withholding proportional to presumed annual income at the IGR rates

figures.applies: Resident employees, from tax year 2026 (Law 141/2025 art. 31 amending art. 101 of Law 166/2013).
